About Talha Alam.
Your digital marketer.

I’m Talha, a freelance digital marketer and BBA student at Amity University. DigitalTalha is my personal brand, built around research, testing and honest communication.

Paid advertising is my main focus. Website creation and SEO connect that work with a clearer home for your services and a useful path from search to enquiry.

Explore my work↗
My journey

From curiosity to practical work.

01

A spark in Class 12

My interest in marketing began with something I came across online during Class 12. Curiosity led me to blogs, videos and books, including Philip Kotler’s Marketing Management and Seth Godin’s work.

02

A structured foundation

I wanted a connected understanding of marketing, so I researched courses and chose the three-month UT Digital Media programme by Umar Tazkeer. Alongside my BBA studies, it gave me a foundation to keep building on.

03

Turning learning into practice

I practised keyword and audience research, campaign structure, ad copy, budget planning, landing-page analysis and conversion tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager. The work taught me to connect the customer, the message and the action being measured.

04

Building DigitalTalha

I created DigitalTalha to give that work a name and a home. It is a solo personal brand: when you work with me, you work directly with me. My aim is to keep improving through useful work and evidence, without inflated claims.

How I think about the work

Understand the problem.
Then choose the approach.

Advertising should make a useful solution easy to understand.

Before writing an ad or planning a page, I want to understand the audience, the problem they have, what they care about and why they would choose one solution over another.

A campaign, a website and an SEO plan all need that foundation. I review the available evidence, explain what it means and use it to decide what needs changing. The first version is a starting point to learn from.
